payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate candidate numerators from n//2+1 down to 1; select first with gcd(a, n-a)=1 and a<n-a.
payload.rationale: The code performs a linear scan over possible numerators; no backtracking, recursion, or branching. The highest scoring subtype is search_backtracking but the algorithm does not exhibit backtracking characteristics.
